entities.name: Marrow-Gnawer
entities.description: Leader of a large nezumi gang in Numai on Kamigawa, who bound himself to the Hyozan Reckoners.

entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: Man who disrupted the soratami parley and tricked Marrow-Gnawer into the hyozan oath.

entities.name: Uramon
entities.description: Takenuma crime overlord who had Marrow-Gnawer tortured and owned a Shadow Gate.

entities.name: Kiku
entities.description: Companion of Marrow-Gnawer sent after Toshi.

entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: Attacker whose eye Marrow-Gnawer stabbed at Minamo.

entities.name: Okiba-Gang
entities.description: Nezumi warrior caste/gang purged by Marrow-Gnawer.

entities.name: Hyozan Reckoners
entities.description: Gang whose oath bound Marrow-Gnawer and Kiku.

entities.name: Soratami
entities.description: Moon people who sought to infiltrate Numai's underground.

entities.name: Numai
entities.description: City where Marrow-Gnawer led his gang.

entities.name: Minamo
entities.description: Place where Marrow-Gnawer stabbed Hidetsugu's eye.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War during which Marrow-Gnawer purged the Okiba-Gang.

events.summary: Marrow-Gnawer assassinates three nezumi makiba, including his brother, and becomes a makiba commanding the largest warrior group in Takenuma Swamp.
events.quote: assassinated three nezumi makiba, members of the leader caste, including his brother.

events.summary: During the Kami War he purges the Okiba-Gang and meets soratami; Toshiro Umezawa disrupts the parley.
events.quote: The parley was, however, disrupted by Toshiro Umezawa , and the nezumi fled wounded.

events.summary: Marrow-Gnawer is captured and tortured by Uramon over his dealings with the soratami.
events.quote: who had him beaten and tortured to extract testimony about his dealings with the soratami.

events.summary: Toshi tricks Marrow-Gnawer and Kiku into the Hyozan Reckoners; bound by the oath they help him neutralize Uramon and steal her Shadow Gate.
events.quote: Toshi tricked Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer into joining the Hyozan Reckoners gang

events.summary: At Minamo Marrow-Gnawer stabs Hidetsugu's eye, saving Kiku and Toshi but invoking the hyozan curse; Toshi ends his suffering with Kiku's ax.
events.quote: Toshi granted Marrow-Gnawer the last mercy of ending his suffering with Kiku's ax.

relations.quote: Bound by the hyozan oath, neither Marrow-Gnawer nor Kiku could hurt Toshi

relations.note: sent by her to bring Toshi back
relations.quote: Uramon sent Marrow-Gnawer and Kiku to bring him back.
